authority: Authored fictional coastal nature reserve; proposed offline environment, not surveyed terrain or certified civil engineering. Existing core geometry and elevations are preserved.
coordinate_system: Metres; X east, Y north, Z up; local building frontage south; yaw about +Z.

ravines.water: intermittent dry gravel/sedge bed; no unverified permanent stream

terrain.height_authority: tools/reserve_plan.py:design_height(x,y); returns unchanged core design_height inside preservation rectangle
terrain.coast_policy: Retain existing coast_x/beach/quay/sea meshes and clip extended dry land to original coast except engineered quay; no eastward infill.

stairs.material: local granite with rough non-slip tread
stairs.purpose: optional steep scenic shortcut; the jogging belt remains stair-free

ground_cut.policy: Cut only beneath exact flight ramp and flat landing profiles; preserve tread geometry and approach datum; smoothly blend exposed banks into existing ground.

vegetation_budget.principle: 3500 is an instance budget; actual canopy coverage is sampled separately and is not claimed from tree count. Preserve deliberate meadow and viewpoint gaps.

utilities.authority: Conceptual visible service assets, with no engineering capacity/compliance claim.

visitor_furniture.campfire: one controlled stone-ring/social pad at[-192,-139], outside roof/canopy exclusions; no claim of real fire permission

validation.scope: Metric planning/profile checks only; actual native terrain contact, bridge supports, stair treads, forest exclusions and interior fixture reachability must be verified after geometry implementation.

full_width_coastal_clearance.scope: Entire ordinary-route width plus10cm, segment edge stations every20cm and32-angle vertex joins; analytic coast_x minus beach_width, or actual preserved quay rectangle[31,37,66,55]. No actual mesh-contact claim.

graded_corridor_earthworks.scope: Analytic ground vs unengineered natural_height at centre and fully graded outer edges, every third source segment; not earthwork volumes or actual mesh proof. Bridges/stairs and protected core excluded.

junction_aprons.policy: Shared short level walking profile; neighboring grades relax within their unchanged declared limits. Existing core terrain and structure landing levels remain authoritative.

site_earthworks.terrace_policy: Broad planted/cut granite shoulders around graded pads; no unsupported floating platforms. Hub and camp levels intentionally step at their short common corner.

retaining_edges.material: local granite retaining wall with capped top and planted upper edge

ground_profile.lower_side: left of directed points_xy; north for this edge
ground_profile.policy: Terrain meets both wall faces at declared terrace levels; interpolate only inside solid wall thickness; locally blend exposed ground into existing pad/route shoulders.

site_earthworks.inspection: Actual mesh cut/fill bank slopes and retaining edge contacts must be inspected after implementation; these are authored site works, not a civil engineering design.
